description: Search the open roles at 204 space companies and agencies (engineers of every discipline, technicians, machinists and welders, mission operators, quality, supply chain and business staff), plus the listings of the job boards the site reads, each naming its employer. Each result gives the role's title, employer, kind of work, posted salary, place, and a link to its page on SpaceJobs.Now, where the person applies. Every filter is optional.

employer.description: An employer (or AI-training program or job board): its slug, e.g. 'spacex', 'blue-origin', or its name. list_space_employers finds the slugs.

kind.description: Kind of work, one of: 'propulsion' (Propulsion), 'mechanical-structures' (Mechanical), 'avionics-electrical' (Avionics), 'rf-communications' (RF & Payloads), 'gnc-flight-software' (Flight Software), 'ground-software' (Software & IT), 'systems-test' (Systems & Test), 'manufacturing' (Technicians), 'launch-mission-ops' (Launch & Ops), 'quality-safety' (Quality), 'science-imaging' (Science & Data), 'supply-chain-facilities' (Supply Chain), 'business-programs' (Programs & Business), 'ai-training' (AI training).

limit.description: How many roles to return (1 to 25).

min_pay_usd.description: Minimum pay as a year's pay in US dollars, e.g. 120000: a role passes when the top of its posted range reaches it.

query.description: Words every role must carry in its title, place, team or schedule, e.g. 'propulsion', 'avionics', 'Starship', 'intern', 'Hawthorne'.

remote.description: Only remote roles, such as ground software, data and some business roles.

sort.description: 'mixed' (the board's own order, employers interleaved), 'newest' or 'highest_pay'.

state.description: A US state: its two-letter code (e.g. 'TX', 'NY') or its name ('Texas').

name: search_space_jobs
title: Search space industry jobs
